one_line: Pahlava minister and engineer who rebuilt Sudarshana Lake’s great dam without new taxes or forced labour in western India.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, medium-tall, lean but sturdy build suggesting a courtier used to travel and field work
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp cheekbones and a straight nose, medium wheat complexion tanned by outdoor work, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, thoughtful dark eyes with a focused, assessing gaze; default expression is calm and observant, often with a faint determined half-smile as if measuring a problem in his mind.
appearance.hair: Dark brown hair, shoulder-length, parted in the middle and combed back smoothly, tied into a low knot at the nape with a narrow red cloth band; no crown but a simple narrow gold circlet-like band across the forehead, plain and unadorned, marking his ministerial status.
appearance.costume: Maurya–early Gupta-era western Indian court attire adapted for field inspection: a knee-length, long-sleeved angarkha-style wrap tunic in unpatterned deep indigo cotton, overlapping left over right and tied with concealed inner ties; over this a sleeveless, slightly shorter, light-cream cotton over-tunic (almost like a vest) with simple brown edging at the armholes and hem, to keep the indigo tunic clean during inspections; lower body in a tightly wrapped off-white dhoti reaching the ankles, pleated neatly in front and tucked at the waist, with a narrow brown stripe along the lower edge; a wide russet-brown cloth girdle (belt) wrapped twice around his waist and knotted on the left side, from which a small cloth pouch hangs; feet in simple dark-brown leather sandals with a single strap over the instep and a back strap; jewellery minimal—small plain gold ear studs, a single thin gold bangle on his right wrist, and a modest rectangular seal-ring on his right hand; over one shoulder he wears a soft, light-grey cotton shawl, narrow and practical, draped from the left shoulder across the chest and back to the right arm, used for warmth and to wipe dust while on site.
appearance.signature: A long, smooth wooden measuring rod about his own shoulder height, slightly darker polished teak with two shallow incised lines near the top, carried in his right hand or slung under his arm, used to gauge heights and lengths when inspecting the Sudarshana Lake embankment.

ref_desc: Suvishakha, son of Kulaipa, is a medium-tall, wheat-complexioned man in his early 40s with shoulder-length dark brown hair tied low, a short beard, deep indigo long-sleeved angarkha, cream sleeveless over-tunic, off-white dhoti, russet-brown girdle, light-grey shawl, simple gold band and studs, brown sandals, and a polished wooden measuring rod as his constant prop, in a deep indigo, off-white, cream, russet brown, and light grey palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Suvishakha, son of Kulaipa, a dignified early-40s Pahlava minister-engineer from ancient Saurashtra: medium-tall and lean, wheat complexion tanned from outdoor work, oval face with sharp cheekbones, straight nose, thoughtful dark eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, his default expression calm and observant with a subtle determined half-smile. His shoulder-length dark brown hair is parted in the middle, combed back smoothly and tied into a low knot with a narrow red cloth band, with a simple plain gold band across his forehead like a modest circlet. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved deep indigo cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic overlapping left over right, over which sits a slightly shorter sleeveless light-cream cotton over-tunic with simple brown edging; below, an off-white ankle-length dhoti with a narrow brown stripe along the lower edge is tightly wrapped and neatly pleated. Around his waist is a wide russet-brown cloth girdle wrapped twice with a knot on the left and a small pouch hanging from it. A narrow light-grey cotton shawl is draped from his left shoulder across his chest and back to his right arm. He has small plain gold ear studs, a thin gold bangle on his right wrist, and a simple rectangular seal-ring, and he wears dark brown leather sandals with a strap over the instep and a back strap. His signature prop is a long polished dark wooden measuring rod about shoulder height, held in his right hand or tucked under his arm, clearly visible. Emphasise the deep indigo, off-white, cream, russet brown, and light grey colour palette, and present him in neutral poses and views suitable for consistent redrawing, without any text or labels.
